name: southern_coast_range
description: 100 x 100 km game region on the south-eastern continent: coastal mountain range, foothills and a river plain; the river reaches the sea ~40 km east of the square. Split into 4 x 4 plots of 25 x 25 km.
centre_note: Chosen so the square spans from the coastal range in the west across the foothills to the river plain in the east (world candidate 4 of the mountain search).
projection: local tangent plane (azimuthal equidistant) centred on centre_lat/lon; x = east, y = north, in metres

tiles.naming: tile_x{col}_y{row}; col 0 = west, row 0 = north (Unreal tiled import order)
tiles.shared_edges: neighbouring tiles share their edge vertices exactly

unreal.landscape_size: 8129 x 8129 (1024 components of 254 x 254, 4 sections of 127 quads)
unreal.heightmap_format: 16-bit grayscale PNG, 32768 = 0 m, 12.8 units per metre (Z scale 1000 because the mountains exceed 256 m)
